result.summary: Found 1 major issue: a content/layout rendering problem with overlapping or missing text in the Tokumaru Ramen Bar listing.

issues.description: The subtitle line under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' shows '25-3[?]delivery • Ramen' — the delivery time range appears to be missing the 'min' label and/or the text is being clipped/overlapped, making it read as '25-3' immediately followed by 'delivery' without proper spacing or unit text.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the delivery time string is fully rendered with the 'min' unit (e.g., '25–35 min') and that the text layout does not truncate or overlap characters. Check for string concatenation bugs or insufficient container width causing text clipping.
